name: masters-pods-shelf/niche-a
refs: THE PICTURE TO EDIT (our painted cabinet, project-owned): a front-on piece of the cabinet: cream plaster, an aged umber wood back-board, the shelf ledge below. Keep its wood, plaster, ledge, light and finish exactly; only add what is asked.

THE LAYOUT (a flat wireframe, project-owned): the dark disc is exactly where the one round niche is carved and how big its mouth is: centred left to right, its mouth almost the full height of the board. Never copy its flat look.

THE NICHE LOOK (our signed concept, project-owned): round niches hollowed into the wood like this, front-on, with soft deep shadow inside. Do NOT copy its rings, the groove or inlay around the mouth, the glow, the star or the pods.
prompt: Edit the cabinet picture: carve ONE round niche into the wood back-board, exactly where and as big as the layout's dark disc (centred left to right, the mouth nearly as tall as the board). Seen perfectly front-on, so the mouth is a true circle. The niche is a smooth, shallow, bowl-like hollow carved straight into the same umber wood, its inner wall curving back to a darker rounded back; the wood grain follows the curve inside. Lantern light from the upper left: the upper-left part of the inner wall is in soft shadow under the lip, the lower-right inner wall catches warm light, and soft ambient occlusion deepens toward the back and the bottom. The mouth's edge is plain, softly rounded wood that meets the board flush: NO groove, NO ring, NO inlay, NO moulding, NO metal, NO line or bevel band around the mouth. The niche is EMPTY: no pod, no object, nothing inside. Everything else in the picture stays exactly as it is: no other niches, no objects, no text, letters, numbers or symbols, no frame. Matte hand-painted miniature finish, low saturation, warm and calm.
